criteria.criterion: Access Google Finance and attempt to locate Apple (AAPL) page
criteria.final_justification: The agent clearly did locate Apple in Google Finance search results (and action history shows a click on AAPL:NASDAQ). But the screenshots do not confirm arrival on Apple’s dedicated quote page—only the suggestion list overlay is visible and later screenshots show a general markets overview. No uncontrollable blocker is visually confirmed (no CAPTCHA/login wall); rather, the agent’s claim that controls are “non-hit-testable” is not supported by screenshots. Keep partial credit for locating Apple but not opening the company page.

criteria.criterion: Access Google Finance and attempt to locate Microsoft (MSFT) page
criteria.final_justification: There is no visual evidence the agent searched for or opened Microsoft’s page. Also, no uncontrollable platform blocker is shown that would prevent searching MSFT (no CAPTCHA/login wall/error). Baseline awarding full credit due to a supposed shared blocker is not supported by images. Score should be 0.

criteria.criterion: Report Apple metrics and latest visible news headline (or unavailability)
criteria.final_justification: The required Apple fields (current share price on the Apple page, market cap, YTD, latest Apple news headline) are not captured. The agent’s output states none are visible; however, screenshots do show Apple-related prices in the dropdown, so the claim that there is ‘no current share price’ visible is overstated. Still, market cap, YTD, and Apple-specific latest news headline are not visible anywhere, and the agent did not report any values. Minimal partial credit for at least reaching a view where an Apple price is visible in search suggestions, but overall the criterion is largely unmet.

criteria.criterion: Report Microsoft metrics and latest visible news headline (or unavailability)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not open Microsoft’s page or report any Microsoft metrics/headlines, and there is no confirmed uncontrollable blocker preventing this. Therefore this criterion is not satisfied.

criteria.criterion: Provide a comparison and identify which company has larger market capitalization
criteria.final_justification: Because the agent did not retrieve comparable data for both companies (and did not provide any market cap values at all), it cannot correctly state which has the larger market capitalization. There is also no uncontrollable blocker shown that would excuse the lack of comparison. Score 0.
